mechanics.claim: Elise will not dash if the target is within basic attack range.
mechanics.quote: '''Elise''' will not dash if the target is within basic attack range.

mechanics.claim: Venomous Bite applies on-hit effects and always deals its damage after the cast time even if the dash is interrupted; it still deals damage without on-hit effects if blocked or dodged.
mechanics.quote: ''Venomous Bite'' will always apply its effects after the cast time, even if the dash is interrupted.

mechanics.claim: Venomous Bite deals damage but not on-hit effects if blocked or dodged.
mechanics.quote: ''Venomous Bite'' will still deal its damage but not apply on-hit effects if it is {{tip|blocked}} or {{tip|dodged}}.

mechanics.claim: Active Spiderlings/Volatile Spiderlings dash alongside Elise on Venomous Bite's cast and attack the target.
mechanics.quote: they will {{tip|dash}} alongside '''Elise''' to the target upon ''Venomous Bite's'' cast and reprioritize them.
